decision_summary: Final review approves QIF v0.6.29 Trial and Infrastructure Uncertainty for release.
rationale: Visionary: the release closes the uncertainty readiness blocker with an auditable, domain-general record. Builder: end-to-end schema, verifier, readiness evaluation, generated fixtures, documentation, and full npm integration pass. Guardian: the assurance boundary is explicit, non-sufficient states route to governance, and no structural result claims trial independence, statistical confidence, causal attribution, semantic truth, or quality.
recommendation: Complete TASK-047, run retrospective and post-situation assessment, verify public residue, then publish v0.6.29.
